krater.speaker: object
krater.text: The krater was the centerpiece of the symposium, an Ancient Greek drinking party filled with wine, women and song.

krater.speaker: object
krater.text: Kraters were wide-rimmed bowls made of ceramic or bronze in which wine was mixed with water and then ladled out to the guests at the symposium.

krater.speaker: object
krater.text: Every Greek household would have a krater for family gatherings and celebrations.

krater.speaker: object
krater.text: The humblest were made of unadorned red ceramic, while wealthier families owned craters with elaborate depictions of the gods making merry.
